settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer a 30-day hassle-free return policy. If you are not completely satisfied, simply reach out to us via our Contact page for a full refund or exchange.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Standard delivery takes 5-10 business days depending on your location. Tracking details will be emailed to you.

settings.question: How can I contact customer support?
settings.answer: You can reach our support team directly through our Contact Us page or via WhatsApp (Number will be updated soon). We are always here to help!
